posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Yeah I have an Early Bird slot locked in. I think the rules are polished in Eric's head, but they were not laid out very clearly. The rule book PDF they released was obviously rushed and not copy edited at all. But I think that was due to that 4 day loss where it wasn't searchable on KS. they needed to get back on track quickly. But it sounds like everything has been extensively playtested from his interviews in a few podcasts I've heard, so I expect the actual gameplay to be rather fast and simple. 

I'd like more teams to unlock, but once the zombies team unlocks, it'll be very hard to pass over the game just in value alone. You do get a lot of plastic for your buck. 

I was never a "minis" guy. But after being more active on KS, it's hard not to love the amazing production value we have been seeing. I hate the micro management of mini games, so something like kaosballs macro focus is very appealing.

posts.cooked:
Boob sculpts. Lmao. 

Honestly? I was surprised to see as many female characters as I did considering it is a blood bath sport. And considering the art style, all features of characters are over emphasized. While breasts are easy to jump on because of our cultures tendency to objectify and over sexualize the female form, I just have a hard time levying that charge against a game like this. As a white heterosexual male, my view point is not surprising and I realise that. 

I think your issue is a valid one none the less. The alienation of female gamers due to the lack of relatable characters is a very real issue that I think more designers and developers are taking notice of. The state of gaming as it relates to women is light years ahead of where it was 10 years ago and I think it's only getting better. 

I mean just look how >G has tackled the subject of gender in designing SotM. It's incredibly impressive and it has played no small part in its growing and loyal fan base I assure you. 

Well I went off on a tangent huh? It's interesting because gaming has historically been a microcosm of a dominantly patriarchal society. Seeing that shift is a rather big deal and its a topic I find fascinating.

posts.cooked:
jagarciao:

Just curious if anyone that backed this has received it and had a chance to play it. I got mine, but haven't gotten it to the table yet. Looks good though. 

Yes I got this. I have found it to be a very simple but satisfying game. Mechanically its very simple at least, but the mind games that emerge in the meta-game for your group is pretty awesome. Lot of bluffing and predicting. Theres bidding phases and stuff. It really has a lot to like about it. Eric has a pretty decent of well designed games and this is not an exception.

Some teams are flat out better than others I think. There is not a great balance when talking every possible 1v1 matchup. Trolls vs Ogres for example, Trolls have such a distinct advantage in that matchup. Ogres will have to pay an arm and a leg to get on even footing through ability/ringer bidding, and I'd imagine Ogres would be happy to let them pay, take cheaper upgrades/ringers, and have a field day with cheat cards during a match.  Barbarians vs Daemons? Yup. Barbarians will win that match every time given equal player skill. No question. Goblins vs Amazons? Again, Goblins stand little chance.

2v2 matches, however, are very fun and feel much more balanced, but thats expected. 4vAll is a bit of a mess since everyone is bashing everyone, but there are a lot of team abilities that are just more effective with more teams in the game. 

Overall I'm very happy with the purchase.
